concept: Cost Explorer filters for AI services
summary: Source-anchored research for Cost Explorer filters for AI services. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: An AI-service subtotal is not total workload cost. FinOps Foundation describes vector databases, orchestration and observability as separately billed supporting tools; Vantage likewise explains why Atlas costs must be combined with application infrastructure costs. Use AI service filters as one component of a reconciled workload cost view. (medium confidence) Sources: https://www.finops.org/insights/ai-spend-budget-busters/ ; https://www.vantage.sh/blog/vantage-launches-mongodb-atlas-costs

MongoDB's Go SDK reference exposes a POST Cost Explorer query-process endpoint under /orgs/{orgId}/billing/costExplorer/usage and a GET usage-results endpoint under that path with a query token. The endpoint listing alone does not establish AI service enumeration or model-level API filtering. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27)
To isolate Automated Embedding charges, open the organization Billing > Cost Explorer page and select Automated Embedding in the Service dropdown. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

To isolate Native Reranking charges, select Native Reranking in Cost Explorer's Service dropdown. Atlas bills the $rerank stage separately from other Voyage AI operations in the project. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

For Native Reranking and the Embedding and Reranking API, MongoDB says Cost Explorer costs derive from metering data and update every 24 hours. These cost views therefore cannot establish instantaneous spend. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/query/native-reranking/billing.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/management/billing.md

Automated Embedding and Native Reranking use token-consumption billing. Treat their service-filtered costs as separate economic inputs when evaluating deployment capacity, rather than interpreting model usage as a cluster tier price. The separation is an accounting inference from their documented billing models. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/crud-embeddings/automated-embedding/billing.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/query/native-reranking/billing.md

Cost Explorer exposes only the largest 19 chart items per month and groups the rest as Other. Its table reflects the selected filters and supports CSV export; monthly history is limited to 18 months. Sales-contract chart usage represents credits rather than dollars. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

For customers with MongoDB sales contracts, the Cost Explorer usage axis represents credits rather than dollars. Including partially matching charges can add general support charges without a matching project or service, so record this setting when comparing filtered totals. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Atlas Cost Explorer supports filtering and grouping usage by organization, project, cluster, and service, plus date filters. Include partially matching charges adds general support charges that may lack the selected resource attribution. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

MongoDB directs Embedding and Reranking API users to filter Cost Explorer by AI model. This instruction is distinct from the Service-dropdown procedures for Automated Embedding and Native Reranking. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Viewing AI billing requires Organization Billing Viewer access or higher. Changing the billing profile or payment method requires Organization Owner or Organization Billing Admin. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

For complete AI application economics, combine the AI service slice with database and infrastructure costs. FinOps Foundation identifies vector databases and supporting tools as additional AI costs; Vantage independently describes combining Atlas invoice data with cloud-provider costs. This is methodological guidance, not independent confirmation of Atlas AI filter labels. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-06) Sources: https://www.finops.org/wg/token-economics-saas/ ; https://www.vantage.sh/blog/vantage-launches-mongodb-atlas-costs

In Atlas Billing > Cost Explorer, select Automated Embedding or Native Reranking in the Service dropdown to isolate those respective costs. The Cost Explorer API also accepts both exact service names. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/crud-embeddings/automated-embedding/billing.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/query/native-reranking/billing.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/2024-05-30/operation/operation-createorgbillingcostexplorerusageprocess

The Cost Explorer API services filter accepts AI Model APIs as a distinct SKU service. The Embedding and Reranking API billing guide identifies AI Model APIs in its invoice service summary. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/2024-05-30/operation/operation-createorgbillingcostexplorerusageprocess ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/management/billing.md

Atlas Cost Explorer supports organization, project, cluster, and service filters and groupings. Use service grouping with project or organization scoping to distinguish AI service charges from cluster charges; this allocation approach is an inference from the supported dimensions. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

The Embedding and Reranking API guide recommends filtering Cost Explorer by AI model. It says costs derive from metering data and update every 24 hours, so the cost view should not be treated as a real-time token meter. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

The general billing guide documents only 18 months of monthly history, displays the largest 19 chart items separately and combines the rest as Other, and disables project or cluster filtering at 1000 corresponding resources. Its filtered table can be exported as CSV. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Vantage described an invoice-based Atlas integration in its February 1, 2023 launch post. It combined Atlas and cloud-provider costs, offered service, organization, cost-category and project filters, and hid corresponding AWS/GCP marketplace line items from its All Resources report. This is historical product evidence, not verification of current AI-specific filter support. (low confidence)
